vector_db_chunks.text: The National Consumer Helpline (NCH) is a Department of Consumer Affairs pre-litigation grievance channel, distinct from adjudication by a Consumer Commission. Its official website currently lists 1915 as the toll-free number from 8 AM to 8 PM and provides online grievance options; these operating hours are time-sensitive service information, not an evergreen legal rule. The NCH says a grievance may take up to 30 days to reach a logical conclusion. This is not a guarantee that the grievance will be resolved, that a particular remedy will be provided, or that the consumer will be satisfied. If the grievance is not resolved to the consumer's satisfaction, the consumer may approach the appropriate Consumer Commission under the applicable law.
